purpose: Create a reproducible bridge from pre-result real-race evidence to the 13 JRA base indices without freehand per-horse 0-100 scores.
problem_closed: Current Production can replay frozen base values and derive DCR/TPI/ZAI/SRI/F3S/T3I, but cannot reproducibly derive HPI/SSI/CFI/RFI/BVI/JTI/CSI/TRI/BWI/GCI/PRI/KGI/VMI from raw real-race evidence.

method.stage_1: Convert objective source facts/symbols/numerics to finite categorical evidence features with deterministic bands.
method.stage_2: Convert feature categories to component scores by the candidate registry.
method.stage_3: Compute each base index by a fixed weighted mean over its own evidence domain; missing features are omitted and remaining weights renormalized only when minimum evidence coverage is met.
method.stage_4: Emit value + rule_id + mapping_version + evidence_refs + source_fact + component trace.
method.stage_5: Use the existing fixed derived-index formulas; do not change TPI/ZAI/SRI/F3S/T3I equations.

newcomer_support.principle: Newcomer is not treated as ability=50. Real available gate/dash, workout, pedigree, rider, stable, body, course/going and market evidence is mapped; absent realized race evidence lowers DCR confidence rather than fabricating past-performance evidence.
newcomer_support.dcr: official_recent, same_course_distance and successful-bodyweight-range receive zero evidence points for a true debutant; training/comments, same-day GCI and market-change evidence remain scoreable.

hard_prohibitions: No retroactive upgrade of HSN 20260921 R04 or any already-started race.
No treating transport-neutral 50 as a model score.
No probability/EV interpretation of candidate index values.

required_sequence: frozen historical training set construction without leakage
PFS comparison where frozen ticket/stake exists

temporal_integrity.hsn_20260921_r04: IMMUTABLE / original pre-race Actual Numerical Calculation remains 0/300; candidate mapping may only be used as POST-START research replay.
temporal_integrity.rule: Race_n result may update Mapping/Calibration State_{n+1}; never rewrite Race_n pre-race grade.
